eyebrow: T-SQL for Database Administrators · Chapter Ten
subtitle: Lesson 41 · Build Your DBA Toolkit

code:
-- Not reusable
SELECT name, recovery_model_desc
FROM sys.databases
WHERE name = 'AdventureWorks2019';

-- Reusable
DECLARE @DatabaseName sysname = NULL;  -- NULL = every database

SELECT name, recovery_model_desc
FROM sys.databases
WHERE (@DatabaseName IS NULL OR name = @DatabaseName);
caption: Same query, same job — but now it runs unedited on any server.
